name: side plank rotation
description: A side plank with an arm rotation under the body. It builds the obliques and shoulder stability.
instructions: Set up in a side plank on one forearm or hand with your top arm raised.
Lift your hips so your body is in a straight line.
Thread your top arm under your torso, rotating your chest toward the floor.
Rotate back and reach the arm up to the ceiling.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.
